nodes.label: cli()
nodes.desc: Parses flags (-D, -I, -P, -Q, -K, -U), points HAPStorage at the persist dir, installs SIGINT/SIGTERM handlers, calls Server.start()

nodes.label: Server
nodes.desc: Orchestrator class; constructor wires api, PluginManager, BridgeService and tracks child bridges by MAC username

nodes.label: Server.loadConfig
nodes.desc: Reads config.json (strips BOM), applies default bridge name/pin/username, validates MAC address and advertiser

nodes.label: Server.start
nodes.desc: Boot sequence: cache from disk, Matter config validation, plugins, platforms/accessories, child bridges, publish bridge

nodes.label: Server.loadAccessories
nodes.desc: For each config.accessories entry: resolve plugin, construct AccessoryPlugin, bridge it or route to a child bridge

nodes.label: Server.loadPlatforms
nodes.desc: For each config.platforms entry: construct PlatformPlugin and classify dynamic/static/independent

nodes.label: IpcService
nodes.desc: JSON-over-stdio channel used by homebridge-config-ui-x: server status, child bridge restart/stop/start, Matter events

nodes.label: HomebridgeAPI
nodes.desc: API version 2.7; exposes hap, matter, user, platformAccessory and emits internal registration events

nodes.label: registerPlatformAccessories
nodes.desc: Stamps _associatedPlugin/_associatedPlatform on each accessory and emits REGISTER_PLATFORM_ACCESSORIES

nodes.label: signalFinished
nodes.desc: Emits APIEvent.DID_FINISH_LAUNCHING; plugins start polling hardware only after this fires

nodes.label: isDynamicPlatformPlugin
nodes.desc: Duck-typing: configureAccessory present means dynamic; accessories callback means legacy static platform

nodes.label: PluginManager
nodes.desc: Builds searchPaths from npm global roots (-g) plus optional custom path; matches homebridge-* identifier pattern

nodes.label: initializeInstalledPlugins
nodes.desc: Loads every discovered plugin, deletes failures, then calls each initializer with the api object

nodes.label: Plugin
nodes.desc: Holds package.json-derived entry point, version, disabled flag and the registered accessory/platform maps

nodes.label: Plugin.load
nodes.desc: Validates engines.homebridge, warns about bundled homebridge/hap-nodejs deps, dynamic-imports the entry module

nodes.label: Plugin.initialize
nodes.desc: Invokes the default-exported initializer function with the api instance

nodes.label: handleRegisterAccessory
nodes.desc: Rejects registrations outside a running initializer; stores constructors keyed by accessory/platform name

nodes.label: BridgeService
nodes.desc: Constructor subscribes to API events; owns bridge accessory, cache arrays, published externals map

nodes.label: Bridge accessory
nodes.desc: new Bridge(bridgeConfig.name, uuid.generate('HomeBridge')): the single accessory HomeKit pairs with

nodes.label: publishBridge
nodes.desc: Fills AccessoryInformation characteristics, builds PublishInfo (username, port, pincode, category BRIDGE), calls bridge.publish()

nodes.label: createHAPAccessory
nodes.desc: Calls plugin getServices()/getControllers(), rejects empty sets, merges AccessoryInformation, wraps in hap-nodejs Accessory

nodes.label: loadPlatformAccessories
nodes.desc: Plugin 1.0 static platforms: waits for accessories(callback), warns every 20s if startup stalls

nodes.label: handlePublishExternalAccessories
nodes.desc: Publishes standalone accessories outside the bridge (IP cameras, TVs); each gets its own HAPServer and port

nodes.label: @homebridge/hap-nodejs
nodes.desc: Dependency carrying the HAP protocol stack: HAPServer, Accessory, Bridge, pairing, mDNS advertising

nodes.label: PlatformAccessory
nodes.desc: EventEmitter mirroring a hap-nodejs Accessory; public context field survives restarts via serialize/deserialize

nodes.label: loadCachedPlatformAccessoriesFromDisk
nodes.desc: Reads the cachedAccessories item via StorageService; on JSON corruption restores from .cachedAccessories.bak

nodes.label: restoreCachedPlatformAccessories
nodes.desc: Iterates a snapshot, resolves renamed plugins by active dynamic platform, replays each accessory into configureAccessory

nodes.label: saveCachedPlatformAccessoriesOnDisk
nodes.desc: Persists the cache on register/update/unregister and on shutdown (teardown)

nodes.label: User
nodes.desc: configPath/persistPath/matterPath/cachedAccessoryPath under ~/.homebridge (or -U override)

nodes.label: ChildBridgeService
nodes.desc: Forks childBridgeFork.js per _bridge username, allocates ports, exposes metadata and restart via IPC

nodes.label: ChildBridgeFork
nodes.desc: Runs inside the forked process: request/response IPC with parent, own BridgeService, publishes when HAP enabled

nodes.label: ChildBridgeFork.loadPlugin
nodes.desc: Strips _bridge keys, builds a fresh HomebridgeAPI/PluginManager, loads exactly one plugin, reports LOADED

nodes.label: MatterBridgeManager
nodes.desc: Optional Matter support: dynamically imported only when bridge.matter is configured; manages MatterServer lifecycle
